answer_1.quote: The aim of the empathetic response generation task is to generate syntactically correct, contextually relevant, and more importantly emotionally appropriate responses following previous dialogue turns.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the performance of the dialogue models, we adopted the following metrics: 1) perplexity; 2) distinct-1 and -2 metrics …; 3) sentence embedding similarity—we used SBERT to obtain an embedding for the generated response as well as the ground-truth and then calculated the cosine similarity between the two embeddings.
